summary: 100-foot Aermotor LS-40 lookout on the Enoree Ranger District in Laurens County, SC, built around 1936; Forest Service use ended in the 1980s; upper deck closed.

facts.design: 100-foot Aermotor LS-40 tower with 7x7-foot metal cab and low hip roof

access.note: Upper deck not open to visitors per HikingWNC; the Register's 2020 visit found the lower steps removed to prevent access, the gate pulled off, and no-trespassing signs on the fence.

visit.trail_note: About a quarter-mile round trip from Tip Top Road, per HikingWNC; the upper deck is listed as closed.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one register page with a 2020 visit report, one Forest Service history page that does not name this tower, and one hiking guide for access. No staffing, fire or repair sources were found, and the story says so. The record's material 'steel' is not stated in the sources read (the register gives an Aermotor LS-40 with a metal cab), so it is not repeated in facts. The 100-foot figure is the register's tower height and is taken as height_m 30.5. The access level 'closed' rests on the 2020 visit and the hiking guide; the current agency status is unknown. The Forest Lookouts page for Tip Top was checked and adds only the county and forest names.
